name: Generated appearance shell to CAD-owned channel Boolean band

coordinate_frame.origin: registered origin of the repaired generated solid after millimetre scaling
coordinate_frame.x_positive: project front, normal to the generated body's symmetry plane
coordinate_frame.z_positive: project up, normal to the desk-support plane

datums.description: protected visible region: head dome and outer tentacle surfaces
editable seam band: tentacle inner curls where channels are cut

allowed: Boolean subtraction of parametric channel solids inside the editable seam band
constrained: remeshing or Boolean operations inside the protected visible region
any change to the declared millimetre scale after registration

assembly.direction: CAD authority is applied after mesh repair and before any manufacturing export
assembly.contact_mode: design authority boundary, not a physical contact
assembly.sequence_notes: Modelled under the assembly lifecycle state because the enumeration has no design-time value. Step1X owns massing and surface character only; every functional dimension is re-created parametrically because the generator works in a normalised cube with no metric units.

dimensions.feature: declared overall bounding envelope ceiling at the released scale

uncontrolled: synthesized hidden geometry from a single image
generator output bounded by a 256-cubed TSDF grid
non-manifold artefacts and floaters before repair

keepouts_and_access: The generated mesh is never a slicer-ready or CAD-native manufacturing authority.
Do not rename or directly convert the dense triangle GLB to STEP and call it editable CAD.
Do not ask the generator for clearances, wall thickness, text or mating surfaces.

evidence.uncertainty_note: After generation the mesh is directly inspectable, so topology and bounding box become measurable facts. What the mesh represents physically remains a generated proposal.

failure_modes.mode: A Boolean is attempted on a self-intersecting or non-manifold generated mesh.
failure_modes.effect: A corrupt solid that slices into unpredictable toolpaths or silently loses the channel.
failure_modes.mitigation: Pass the manifold and self-intersection audit before any Boolean and re-audit afterwards.

failure_modes.mode: The generated body is used at its apparent glTF size instead of the declared millimetre scale.
failure_modes.effect: Every functional channel dimension is wrong by an unknown factor.
failure_modes.mitigation: Set physical scale deliberately from the design contract and record the registration matrix.

acceptance_criteria: The repaired solid is watertight and manifold with zero self-intersections before and after the Boolean.
The released bounding box is within the declared 125 x 125 x 65 mm envelope ceiling.
